== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-collision-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Collision!]] (Decipher, 1995; Decipher's [[Collision! (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes to the errata wording, the same words as [[Collision! (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's November 1998 errata]]: “Use 1 Force if opponent has at least two starships present at same system or sector. Draw destiny. If destiny &lt; number of those starships, opponent must lose one of them.” The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “Collision!” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
